meta.title: A surrogate bid may require approval before it counts
gaps: Place a surrogate bid in an eligible open round: the prepared RFQ is closed and cannot be reopened using the available steps.
Establish the required surrogate-bid approval configuration; the prepared event has default settings and no step changes that configuration.
Assert that the new surrogate bid has approval-requested status and does not yet count as active.
Access the approver's task list and assert that it contains the surrogate-bid approval task.

steps.note: Open the fixed prepared event as required.
